name: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense
storyline:
The tide of war has already turned unfavorably, with the alliance's banners reaching just before the Dark Lord's Castle. In response, the Dark Lord appoints his daughter, Princess Lua, as the head of the First Combat Division, her last hope.
Lua must directly command the battlefield against the corrupted mana-wielding hero alliance. She has to prove her lineage's tactical prowess and mastery over dark powers. Thrown into diverse regions and extreme environments, Lua's leadership will be tested as the true heir to the Dark Lord. Defeat means destruction; victory signifies the resurgence of the demon realm.
summary: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.
